12:45 Local Time, 07:15 GMT, 12:45 IST: With the 2027 ODI World Cup now less than a year away, every series from here on will inevitably be viewed through the lens of the showpiece event in South Africa, Zimbabwe and Namibia. For India, where the spotlight is rarely dim, every performance will bring its share of interest, praise and scrutiny. Hello and welcome, everyone! It’s time for the first ODI between India and West Indies in Thiruvananthapuram.

On paper, it is a contest between the No.1 and No.10 teams in the ODI rankings. WI’s record vs India makes for difficult reading. They have not won an ODI series in India since 2002, while their last series win against India came in 2006. Since then, they have lost 13 consecutive ODI series against the Men in Blue. West Indies will also have a longer road to the 2027 World Cup, with their place in the tournament to be decided through the Qualifiers. Shai Hope and his men have their work cut out. But India are hardly entering this series without questions of their own, having lost two of their last three ODI series. So, can WI spring a surprise, or will India have it their way once again?
